name: publish-guard
description: Stops Claude from typing private terms into the browser or writing them into your publishing files, and keeps a log of what it blocked

blocked_terms.title: Blocked terms
blocked_terms.description: Comma-separated words, names or domains that must never go out (case-insensitive). Stored in your settings; never shown in the pane or messages.

allowed_terms.title: Allowed terms
allowed_terms.description: Comma-separated exceptions. These are ignored before checking, e.g. a Korean name you credit on purpose.

guarded_paths.title: Guarded paths
guarded_paths.description: Comma-separated pieces of a file path. A Write or Edit to a path containing any of them is checked.

block_non_latin.title: Block a script
block_non_latin.description: korean also blocks Korean text (minus allowed terms) from going out.
